# Every team's oldest EURO appearance-maker and scorer
Tuesday, July 9, 2024
## Article summary
Who are the oldest players to have played and scored for the EURO 2024 contenders at a EURO finals?
## Article top media content
![Pepe is Portugal's oldest-ever EURO player – and the oldest of any participating nation](https://editorial.uefa.com/resources/026a-129eec2dc299-71085f0ddb6c-1000/format/wide1/hungary_v_portugal_-_uefa_euro_2020_group_f.jpeg?imwidth=158)
Pepe is Portugal's oldest-ever EURO player – and the oldest of any participating nation UEFA via Getty Images
## Article body
Portugal defender Pepe holds the [record as the oldest player](https://www.uefa.com/euro2024/news/0255-0d9f314b43c6-cc417c03547d-1000--pepe-sets-new-record-as-oldest-player-to-appear-at-a-euro/) to have featured in a UEFA EURO finals match, gracing the pitch at the age of 41 years 130 days against France in the 2024 edition.
UEFA.com discovers each EURO 2024 nation's oldest appearance-maker and scorer. 
### **Albania**
Oldest player: **Klaus Gjasula** , 34 years 188 days (vs Croatia, [EURO 2024](https://www.uefa.com/euro2024/match/2036176--croatia-vs-albania/))  
Oldest scorer: **Klaus Gjasula** , 34 years 188 days (vs Croatia, [EURO 2024](https://www.uefa.com/euro2024/match/2036176--croatia-vs-albania/))  

### **Austria**
Oldest player: **Ivica Vastic** , 38 years 257 days (vs Poland, [EURO 2008](https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuro/history/seasons/2008/))  
Oldest scorer: **Ivica Vastic** , 38 years 257 days (vs Poland, [EURO 2008](https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuro/history/seasons/2008/))
![Austria's Ivica Vastic after scoring against Poland at EURO 2008](https://img.uefa.com/imgml/void.svg)
Austria's Ivica Vastic after scoring against Poland at EURO 2008Getty Images
### **Belgium**
Oldest player: **Jan Vertonghen** , 37 years 68 days (vs France, [EURO 2024](https://www.uefa.com/euro2024/match/2036193--ukraine-vs-belgium/))  
Oldest scorer: **Julien Cools** , 33 years 123 days (vs Spain, [EURO '80](https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuro/history/seasons/1980/))  

### **Croatia**
Oldest player: **Luka Modrić** , 38 years 289 days (vs Italy, [EURO 2024](https://www.uefa.com/euro2024/match/2036176--croatia-vs-albania/))  
Oldest scorer: **Luka Modrić** , 38 years 289 days (vs Italy, [EURO 2024](https://www.uefa.com/euro2024/match/2036176--croatia-vs-albania/))  

### **Czechia**
Oldest player: **Tomáš Rosický** , 35 years 257 days (vs Croatia, [EURO 2016](https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuro/history/seasons/2016/))  
Oldest scorer: **Jan Koller** , 35 years 77 days (vs Turkey, [EURO 2008](https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuro/history/seasons/2008/))
![Czechia's Tomáš Rosický at EURO 2016](https://img.uefa.com/imgml/void.svg)
Czechia's Tomáš Rosický at EURO 2016Getty Images
### **Denmark**
Oldest player: **Morten Olsen** , 38 years 308 days (vs Italy, [EURO '88](https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuro/history/seasons/1988/))  
Oldest scorer: **Christian Eriksen** , 32 years 123 days (vs Slovenia, [EURO 2024](https://www.uefa.com/euro2024/match/2036165--slovenia-vs-denmark/)) 
### **England**
Oldest player: **Peter Shilton** , 38 years 271 days (vs Netherlands, [EURO '88](https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuro/history/seasons/1988/))  
Oldest scorer: **Trevor Brooking** , 31 years 260 days (vs Spain, [EURO '80](https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuro/history/seasons/1980/))
![Peter Shilton leads England out at EURO '88](https://img.uefa.com/imgml/void.svg)
Peter Shilton leads England out at EURO '88Bob Thomas Sports Photography vi
### **France**
Oldest player: **Olivier Giroud** , 37 years 283 days (vs Spain, [EURO 2024](https://www.uefa.com/euro2024/match/2036209--spain-vs-france/))  
Oldest scorer: **Laurent Blanc** , 34 years 205 days (vs Denmark, [EURO 2000](https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuro/history/seasons/2000/))  

### **Georgia**
Oldest player: **Guram Kashia** , 36 years 362 days (vs Spain, [EURO 2024](https://www.uefa.com/euro2024/match/2036199--spain-vs-georgia/))   
Oldest scorer: **Georges Mikautadze** , 23 years 239 days (vs Portugal, [EURO 2024](https://www.uefa.com/euro2024/match/2036196--georgia-vs-portugal/))  

### **Germany**
Oldest player: **Lothar Matthäus** , 39 years 91 days (vs Portugal, [EURO 2000](https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuro/history/seasons/2000/))  
Oldest scorer: **Miroslav Klose** , 34 years 13 days (vs Greece, [EURO 2012](https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuro/history/seasons/2012/))
![Miroslav Klose celebrates his goal against Greece at EURO 2012](https://img.uefa.com/imgml/void.svg)
Miroslav Klose celebrates his goal against Greece at EURO 2012AFP via Getty Images
### **Hungary**
Oldest player: **Gábor Király** , 40 years 86 days (vs Belgium, [EURO 2016](https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuro/history/seasons/2016/))  
Oldest scorer: **Zoltán Gera** , 37 years 61 days (vs Portugal, [EURO 2016](https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuro/history/seasons/2016/))  

### **Italy**
Oldest player: **Gianluigi Buffon** , 38 years 156 days (vs Germany, [EURO 2016](https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuro/history/seasons/2016/))  
Oldest scorer: **Christian Panucci** , 35 years 62 days (vs Romania, [EURO 2008](https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuro/history/seasons/2008/))  

### **Netherlands**
Oldest player: **Maarten Stekelenburg** , aged 38 years 278 days (vs Czechia, [EURO 2020](https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuro-2020/match/2024443--netherlands-vs-austria/))  
Oldest scorer: **Giovanni van Bronckhorst** , 33 years 125 days (vs Italy, [EURO 2008](https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuro/history/seasons/2008/))
![Netherlands goalkeeper Maarten Stekelenburg at EURO 2020](https://img.uefa.com/imgml/void.svg)
Netherlands goalkeeper Maarten Stekelenburg at EURO 2020POOL/AFP via Getty Images
### **Poland**
Oldest player: **Kamil Grosicki** , 36 years 13 days (vs Austria, [EURO 2024](https://www.uefa.com/euro2024/match/2036179--poland-vs-austria/))  
Oldest scorer: **Robert Lewandowski** , 35 years 309 days (vs France, [EURO 2024](https://www.uefa.com/euro2024/match/2036191--france-vs-poland/))  

### **Portugal**
Oldest player: **Pepe** , 41 years 130 days (vs France, [EURO 2024](https://www.uefa.com/euro2024/match/2036206--portugal-vs-france/))  
Oldest scorer: **Cristiano Ronaldo** , 36 years 138 days (vs France, [EURO 2020](https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuro-2020/match/2024466--portugal-vs-germany/))  

### **Romania**
Oldest player: **Florin Niță** , 36 years 365 days (vs Netherlands, [EURO 2024](https://www.uefa.com/euro2024/match/2036203--romania-vs-netherlands/))  
Oldest scorer: **Dorinel Munteanu** , 31 years 361 days (vs England, [EURO 2000](https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuro/history/seasons/2000/))  

### **Scotland**
Oldest player: **David Marshall** , 36 years 109 days (vs Croatia, [EURO 2020](https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuro-2020/match/2024443--netherlands-vs-austria/))  
Oldest scorer: **Ally McCoist** , aged 33 years 268 days (vs Switzerland, [EURO '96](https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuro/history/seasons/1996/))  

### **Serbia**
Oldest player: **Dušan Tadić** , 35 years 218 days (vs Denmark, [EURO 2024](https://www.uefa.com/euro2024/match/2036190--denmark-vs-serbia/))  
Oldest scorer: **Ljubinko Drulović** , 31 years 276 days (vs Slovenia, [EURO 2000](https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuro/history/seasons/2000/))
![Ljubinko Drulović in action against Slovenia at EURO 2000](https://img.uefa.com/imgml/void.svg)
Ljubinko Drulović in action against Slovenia at EURO 2000Getty Images
### **Slovakia**
Oldest player: **Peter Pekarík** , aged 37 years 244 days (vs England, [EURO 2024](https://www.uefa.com/euro2024/match/2036200--england-vs-slovakia/))  
Oldest scorer (for Czechoslovakia): **Ladislav Pavlovič** , 34 years 92 days (vs France, [EURO '60](https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuro/history/seasons/1960/))   
Oldest scorer (for Slovakia): **Ivan Schranz** , 30 years 291 days (vs England, [EURO 2024](https://www.uefa.com/euro2024/match/2036200--england-vs-slovakia/))  

### **Slovenia**
Oldest player: **Josip Iličić** , 36 years 154 days (vs Portugal, [EURO 2024](https://www.uefa.com/euro2024/match/2036201--portugal-vs-slovenia/))  
Oldest scorer: **Erik Janža** , 30 years 361 days (vs Denmark, [EURO 2024](https://www.uefa.com/euro2024/match/2036165--slovenia-vs-denmark/))  

### **Spain**
Oldest player: **Jesús Navas** , 38 years 231 days (vs France, [EURO 2024](https://www.uefa.com/euro2024/match/2036209--spain-vs-france/))  
Oldest scorer: **Dani Carvajal** , 32 years 156 days (vs Croatia, [EURO 2024](https://www.uefa.com/euro2024/match/2036163--spain-vs-croatia/))
![Dani Carvajal  after scoring against Croatia at EURO 2024](https://img.uefa.com/imgml/void.svg)
Dani Carvajal after scoring against Croatia at EURO 2024AFP via Getty Images
### **Switzerland**
Oldest player: **Pascal Zuberbühler** , 37 years 159 days (vs Portugal, [EURO 2008](https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuro/history/seasons/2008/))  
Oldest scorer: **Xherdan Shaqiri** , 32 years 253 days (vs Scotland, [EURO 2024](https://www.uefa.com/euro2024/match/2036174--scotland-vs-switzerland/))  

### **Türkiye**
Oldest player: **Burak Yılmaz** , 35 years 340 days (vs Switzerland, [EURO 2020](https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuro-2020/match/2024450--belgium-vs-russia/))  
Oldest scorer: **Cenk Tosun** , 33 years 19 days (vs Czechia, [EURO 2024](https://www.uefa.com/euro2024/match/2036195--czechia-vs-turkiye/))  

### **Ukraine**
Oldest player: **Anatoliy Tymoshchuk** , 37 years 83 days (vs Poland, [EURO 2016](https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuro/history/seasons/2016/))  
Oldest scorer: **Andriy Shevchenko** , 35 years 256 days (vs Sweden, [EURO 2012](https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuro/history/seasons/2012/))
![Andriy Shevchenko after scoring his second and final EURO goal](https://img.uefa.com/imgml/void.svg)
Andriy Shevchenko after scoring his second and final EURO goalAFP via Getty Images
